use_case: Face verification (1:1) at the 2 County A government center employee entrances: the reader compares a live face image with the enrolled template of the badge presented
business_owner: Security Systems Manager (for County A, which decides on use)
vendor_or_model: Access control SaaS vendor face verification module (machine learning face matching) with 6 face-capable readers
build_or_buy: Configure (vendor feature configured by the company)
data_categories: Face templates (treated as biometric data); enrollment photos; badge IDs; match scores; access events
consequential_decision_category: Safety/CI (physical access to a government facility)
human_in_the_loop: Face match is a second factor with the badge. A failed match falls back to badge plus PIN or the guard desk; no one is refused entry on a face result alone
applicable_laws: Fla. Stat. 501.171 (biometric data is personal information; reasonable security; third-party agent notice); Fla. Stat. 501.702 definition (exclusion for data generated from video: counsel to confirm); Fla. Stat. 119.071(5)(g) (biometric exemption limited to fingerprints and friction ridge records) and 119.0701; FTC Act Section 5 (claims); County A addendum
status: In production (restricted): no new enrollments until the conditions are met by 2026-10-31
